fields.description: Ocean Cove is a two-building collection of one- to three-bedroom apartments in Rashid Yachts & Marina. Gardens, swimming and recreation spaces give the residential setting a quieter focus beside the wider waterfront district. The floor plans offer distinct balcony arrangements, with dedicated utility and storage spaces in selected larger homes.

overview: Ocean Cove’s brochure emphasises open kitchens, private outdoor space and practical bedroom storage. Its shared landscaped areas connect to the larger marina district, where the promenade and retail/dining offering form part of the surrounding community. Nearby school and clinic references in launch material should be checked for operational status before planning a move.
research.locationNote: Ocean Cove is at Rashid Yachts & Marina in Mina Rashid, Dubai. Emaar identifies the QE2 Hotel and access towards Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall and Dubai International Airport. Confirm the selected home’s orientation and the completion of neighbouring facilities rather than assuming all marketed outlooks are available.
research.priceNote: On the review date Emaar’s displayed selection starts at AED 3,229,888, while its static launch headline remains AED 1.76m. The launch fact sheet starts one-bedroom homes at AED 1.76m, two-bedroom at AED 2.50m and three-bedroom at AED 3.44m. Current stock and unit-specific terms require reconfirmation.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule has 10% at booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% on estimated completion. Property Finder corroborates 10/70/20. Dates and construction milestones below are historical launch terms, not a personalised payment demand.
research.handoverNote: The launch payment document estimates August 2028, also reported by Property Finder. Confirm the current building-specific contractual date and progress.

facts.label: Launch unit mix
facts.value: The launch sheet lists 100 one-bedroom, 105 two-bedroom and 28 three-bedroom apartments, totalling 233 homes. It does not describe remaining inventory.

facts.label: Three-bedroom example
facts.value: Building 1 unit 105 has a utility room, separate laundry, storage cupboards and a walk-in wardrobe beside the main bedroom. Its balconies serve different parts of the home.

facts.label: Total area includes outdoor space
facts.value: That unit’s 1,798.44 sq ft total combines a 1,460.45 sq ft suite with 337.99 sq ft of balconies. Compare indoor space separately when choosing between layouts.
